title: Critique: folk psychology commits to so little that it will survive

statements.text: Some defenders hold that folk psychology, though a theory, is austere and ontologically noncommittal, requiring very little for vindication. Then it is compatible with a very wide range of neuroscientific and cognitive developments, and eliminative materialism is possible but unlikely.

sources.locator: section 4.3, 'Defending the Virtues of Folk Psychology'
sources.quote: folk psychology can be seen as compatible with a very wide range of neuroscientific or cognitive developments, making eliminative materialism possible but unlikely
